maidllmlocal.autologin.ok: MAICA auto-login succeeded (as %s): token written to local site config, chat away
maidllmlocal.autologin.hint: → Use /maidllmlocal set to open the settings screen; hitting Log in there takes effect immediately (no need to re-enter the world). Login accepts the forum ID OR the registration email, but the backend matches exactly (ID is case-sensitive; a nickname is not the login ID); if you edit the JSON by hand, remember to escape quotes and backslashes; you can test the same values on the forum.monika.love login page. (Identical bad credentials are not retried within one game session, to avoid the fail2ban lockout.)
maidllmlocal.screen.title: MAICA Settings
maidllmlocal.screen.mt: MTrigger (lets her change work mode / affection / memories)
maidllmlocal.screen.session.invalid: Session must be an integer between -1 and 9 (-1 = not hosted, 0-9 = use the backend's hosted memory)
maidllmlocal.screen.login.kept: A token already exists; only your settings were synced (use Clear token first to switch accounts)
maidllmlocal.screen.login.nocreds: Enter an account and password first
maidllmlocal.screen.saved: Saved (a token is only fetched when you hit Log in)
maidllmlocal.screen.cleared: Token cleared (your account file is kept; hit Log in to fetch a new one)
maidllmlocal.screen.status.token.no: Local token: missing (enter your account, then Log in)
maidllmlocal.screen.status.server.off: Server-side MTrigger: off (yours won't take effect)
maidllmlocal.screen.status.server.unknow: Server-side MTrigger: unknown (server lacks this mod, or is older)
maidllmlocal.screen.hint.server: The server half (MTrigger / session) is admin-only; in single-player both halves share one file
maidllmlocal.screen.login.rejected: These credentials were already rejected by the server this session, so the retry was skipped (to avoid the fail2ban lockout). Change the account and hit Log in again, or restart the game.
